label: Dot Matrix Field
author: Conky-Studio
description: Grid of dots whose brightness follows a radial falloff from centre, modulated by Trigger. Soft ambient / equalizer backdrop.
lua_draw_body:
local cols, rows = math.floor({cols}+0.5), math.floor({rows}+0.5)
 local sp, dr = {spacing}, {dot_radius}
 local energy = math.min(tonumber({trigger}) or 0, 100) / 100
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local t = wall_clock()
 local cx = (cols - 1) / 2
 local cy = (rows - 1) / 2
 local maxd = math.sqrt(cx*cx + cy*cy); if maxd < 1 then maxd = 1 end
 for j = 0, rows - 1 do
  for i = 0, cols - 1 do
   local dx, dy = i - cx, j - cy
   local d = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) / maxd
   local bright = (1 - d) * (0.25 + 0.75 * energy)
   if {animate} then
    bright = bright * (0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(t * 2.1 + i * 0.7 + j * 0.5))
   end
   if bright > 0.02 then
    cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * bright)
    cairo_arc(cr, {x} + i * sp, {y} + j * sp, dr, 0, 2 * math.pi)
    cairo_fill(cr)
   end
  end
 end
